name: Tabby Grunt
bestiary: The rank and file of the Feline Armada. Orange, loud, and always hungry. Easily distracted by sunbeams.

name: Tuxedo Diver
bestiary: Dressed for a gala, behaves like a cannonball. Loves swooping at poodles from great heights.

name: Siamese Spitter
bestiary: Talkative and opinionated. Hacks hairballs with alarming accuracy while yelling about dinner.

name: Calico Splitter
bestiary: Three colors, two kittens. Boop a calico and her kittens scatter in every direction.

name: Persian Puffball
bestiary: So much fur that the first turd barely registers. Thinks it is royalty. Might be right.

name: Scottish Fold Yarnwitch
bestiary: Folded ears, unfolded ambitions. Kidnaps lost puppies and flings yarn. Boop one carrying a pup to set it free!

name: Bengal Bolt
bestiary: A tiny leopard with a big ego. The fastest diver in the Armada.

name: Sphynx Zigzagger
bestiary: Hairless, fearless, and impossible to predict. Weaves side to side on every dive.

name: Maine Coon Bruiser
bestiary: The size of a small dog and proud of it. Takes three good turds to send home.

name: Russian Blue Sniper
bestiary: Silver coat, green eyes, cold aim. Fires hairballs from deep in formation.

name: Runaway Kitten
bestiary: Small, zoomy, and fleeing its calico mother. Worth a quick boop.

name: Sergeant Whiskers
bestiary: The backyard bully. Has been sitting on the fence glaring at Pom since she was a puppy.

name: Tuxedo Tom
bestiary: A dapper menace who rules Maple Street from the top of a mailbox.

name: Duchess Fluffbottom
bestiary: She considers the dog park her personal lawn. She has never once been on a leash.

name: Big Sal, the Bodega Boss
bestiary: Runs Bodega Alley from atop the chip rack. Respects anyone who can out-hustle him.

name: Madame Mau
bestiary: A Siamese diva who sings from water towers at 3 AM. Her hairballs come in spirals.

name: Barista Patches
bestiary: Pulls shots of espresso and kittens in equal measure.

name: Captain Mainsail
bestiary: A Maine Coon sea captain who smells permanently of tuna.

name: Foreman Fold
bestiary: Runs the Yarn Factory. Every ball of yarn the Armada flings came off his line.

name: Ace Pilot Sphynx
bestiary: Top gun of the Armada. Wears goggles for drama. Has no fur to ruffle.

name: Commodore Blue
bestiary: Guards the Litter Moon with icy precision.

name: The Catnip Kingpin
bestiary: A very relaxed tabby who has spent far too long in the nebula.

name: Admiral Floof
bestiary: Commander of the Scratching-Post Station and keeper of the Empress's schedule.

name: Empress Fluffington
bestiary: Supreme ruler of the Feline Armada. Stole every squeaky toy in Brooklyn. Secretly just wants a friend.
